title: A Loom for the Winter Market

lineage.work_title: A Loom for the Winter Market

chapters.title: Names at the Door
chapters.body: At 15:20 on 9 October, Iona Tern alone wore the badge Cedar. Pell Dace alone wore the badge Flax. The workshop's badge list records both assignments.

chapters.title: The Red Bolt
chapters.body: At 15:20 on 9 October, Cedar alone cut the ceremonial ribbon from the red bolt. Flax did not participate in that cut. The workbench entry identifies the workers only by their badges.

chapters.title: The Sable Bowl
chapters.body: At 16:00 on 9 October, the Sable bowl measured exactly 28 cm across its rim. The inspector measured it twice and entered the same diameter on both lines of the inspection card.

chapters.title: The Last Verse
chapters.body: At 17:00 on 9 October, Orel Moss completed the market's opening-song rehearsal. The musicians packed their instruments after the final verse.

chapters.title: Three Cranes
chapters.body: At 18:00 on 9 October, the paper cranes numbered P1, P2 and P3 were all green. Their small number tags were attached beneath their wings.

chapters.title: The Display Window
chapters.body: At 18:00 on 9 October, the display window held exactly three paper cranes: P1, P2 and P3. There were no other paper cranes in the window.

chapters.title: Bound for Rowan Hall
chapters.body: At 18:30 on 9 October, a dispatch slip recorded that the wall hanging had been sent to Rowan Hall. The recipient signature box was blank; the slip contained no arrival time or acknowledgement.

chapters.title: Before Closing
chapters.body: The closing book for 9 October says the cash tin was counted and the south shutter was lowered before 20:00. It gives neither an individual time for either task nor their order.
